sources.title: AETHORIA-AI/TR-HASH-MoE-100M-70B-Agentic-SFT · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Full-parameter SFT, 3 epochs, 9,429 optimizer steps. 4 GPUs, per-rank batch size 8, packed sequence length 2,048. AdamW, peak learning rate 1e-5, 3% warmup, cosine decay to 1e-6. Assistant-only supervision with the native Agentic special-token template. Best checkpoint selected by matched validation loss.
